rookie.name: Rookie

billing.description: Free for up to two teams. Upgrade only when you need more.

veteran.name: Veteran
features: Up to 5 authorized staff per team

billing.description: Pay only for teams beyond the first two freebies.
billing.cta: Scale to multiple programs with predictable monthly pricing.

billing.description: Flat annual pricing for unlimited programs and staff.
billing.cta: Best choice for districts running every sport and club.
